The brain builds balance from vision, vestibular input and body sense.
Combining this information is called sensory integration.
When senses disagree, like reading on a ship, nausea can appear.
This is motion sickness, best explained by sensory conflict theory.
When senses conflict, the vestibular system acts as a kind of referee.
